0022600169.text: The Nuggets (3-2, third in the Northwest and one game back, 8th in the West) host the Portland Trail Blazers (4-1, first in the Northwest, 3rd in the West) in Denver's sixth game of the season, with the Nuggets on a two-game winning streak and 3-2 over their last ten. Denver is missing Alpha Diallo (out, personal reason), Julian Strawther (out, knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (out, hamstring), while Portland is without Ja Morant (out, hamstring) and Shaedon Sharpe (out, knee surgery). The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, but Denver won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 137-132 home win over Portland on April 6, 2026.
